findings.title: Lightning X2 stun skips only 1 turn instead of 2
findings.description: gameEngine.js returns appliesStun:true but BattleArena.jsx sets only isStunned:true on defender (single-turn skip via advanceTurn). Lightning X2 should apply sleepTurns:2 for a 2-turn skip. Requires: BattleArena detectLIGHTNING in characterMove.name and set sleepTurns accordingly.

findings.title: DiceRollerModal clash phase does not re-roll on tie
findings.description: When attacker roll equals defender roll during clash (not first-player determination), the code treats it as a loss instead of triggering re-roll. GameSetup handles first-player ties correctly; DiceRollerModal clash phase should have similar logic.

findings.title: Per-modifier damage calculation not independently tested
findings.description: gameEngine.js and BattleArena.jsx changes appear sound, but manual testing with a per-move (e.g., Fire of Fury die × 5) is needed to confirm damage totals match expectation and HP decrements are correct with ATTACK X1 and X2.

findings.title: IDOL card removal status unclear
findings.description: cards.js has no diff. Current codebase has no IDOL references (grep confirmed), but unclear if this is from prior commit or was missed in this pass. Verify before production release.

findings.title: Inconsistent stun/sleep architecture across combat types
findings.description: Shadow Purrr and general combat use isStunned (single-turn), while Kontrol and Lightning should use sleepTurns (multi-turn counter). For Shadow Purrr 1-turn intended behavior this works; for Lightning X2 it fails. Consider unified stun handling in future refactor.

findings.title: Idle warning banner may persist if player resumes action
findings.description: 9-minute warning displays but is not actively cleared when player takes action. Test that warning disappears when user resumes activity after warning triggers.

findings.title: Level field may be undefined in loaded game states
findings.description: gameEngine initializes level:1 on creation, but loaded saves may lack this field. Most UI uses defensive level||1 fallback, but a full audit is recommended to prevent 'Lv.undefined' displays.
